title: Assessment of differences in immune responses to albumin compared with crystalloids for resuscitation in sepsis
description: Crystalloid fluid is central to the management of sepsis, but 5% human albumin solution may offer advantageous immune and intravascular filling properties. We explored whether the choice of first line fluid for resuscitation in sepsis affects the immunological response.
